## Setting things up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library("here")
```

```{r}
base_url <- "http://userweb.eng.gla.ac.uk/umer.ijaz/bioinformatics/ecological/"
raw_data_path <- here("data/_raw/")

SPE <- read_csv(file = str_c(base_url, "SPE_pitlatrine.csv"))
write_csv(x = SPE,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "SPE_pitlatrine.csv"))

ENV <- read_csv(file = str_c(base_url, "ENV_pitlatrine.csv"))
write_csv(x = ENV,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "ENV_pitlatrine.csv"))
```

```{r}
SPE |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -Taxa,
               names_to = "Samples",
               values_to = "OTU_Count")  |> 
  full_join(ENV, by = "Samples") |> 
  mutate(site = case_when(str_detect(Samples, "^T") ~ "Tanzania",
                          str_detect(Samples, "^V") ~ "Vietnam")) |>  
  write_tsv(file = here("data/SPE_ENV.tsv"))
```

```{r}
SPE_ENV <- read_tsv(file = here("data/SPE_ENV.tsv"))
SPE_ENV
```


### Task 9: Group assignment

```{r}
env_numeric <- ENV |>
  select(-Samples)

pca_result <- prcomp(env_numeric, scale. = TRUE)

variance_explained <- summary(pca_result)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca_result$x) |>
  mutate(Samples = ENV$Samples,
         site = if_else(str_starts(Samples, "T_"), "Tanzania", "Vietnam"))

ggplot(data = pca_scores,
       mapping = aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(variance_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(variance_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Site",
       title = "PCA of environmental variables across samples") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Tanzania" = "#E76F51", "Vietnam" = "#2A9D8F")) +
  # Out favorite colors
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
```
